sections.content: The content may be a bit poor for those pursuing a degree in business-related majors, but it's just appropriate for an introductory course. If you are interested in more economic knowledge or want it to be more challenging, I recommend 2103.
sections.teaching: Very good teaching. The instructor was trying to ensure everyone with different backgrounds could understand and indeed he did. Also, attendance is not recorded so you will have much flexibility in managing your time.
sections.grading: I suppose it has a very wide A range because I didn't perform very well in the exams, midterm 35/40, and final 84/102. Both of them was slightly higher than UQ(midterm:34, final 82.75) but yet I got an A- for my final grade.
sections.workload: There isn't really much workload and all assignments can be finished within half an hour. You can get full marks for your assignment as long as you finish it.
